## Projects Department Health & Safety Standards

Ref:EGY/PRJCTS/HSE/REQs

Plan,Do, Check,Act Cycle

<!-- image -->

- The main purpose of measuring health and safety performance is to provide information on progress and current status of strategies, processes and activities employed to control health and safety risk.
- Measurement will be proactive and reactive and all entities are to have effective procedures in place to captureboth types of information.
- Proactive measurement will help in identifying trends and taking action before things go wrong and will include:
- Daily observations and monitoring of:
- Regular health and safety inspections
- HSEAssessments and audits
- ?Review of data from abovc to idcntify trends and producing improvement plans or initiatives
- Reactive monitoring happens after things go wrong and will involve looking at previous events to learn from mistakes and seewhat can be put right to prevent a recurrence.
- Reactive monitoring will include arrangements to identify and report:
- Injuries andwork-relatedill health.
- Other losses such asproperty damage.
- Incidents, including those with the potential to cause injury, ill health or loss (near misses).
- ?Weaknesses or omissions in performance standards and systems.
- Program Partncrs shall devise a range of proactive and reactive Health and Safety related Key Performance Indicators (KPI's) to measure and report on the effectiveness of their HSMS.

Theinformation containedinthese documents is confidential,privilegedandmaynotbe used,published orredistribute thepriorwrittenconsent ofEmaarMisrS.A.E.
